title: SPD-Faith Bench: Diagnosing and Improving Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using symmetric binary queries (e.g., asking both 'Are the two pictures the same?' and 'Are the two pictures different?') and measuring the Contradiction Rate (CR) to determine if the model simply defaults to affirming the user's premise under visual uncertainty.

Conducting controlled perturbation studies by adding textual cues (explicit and implicit hints) and applying random image masking to quantify the model's reliance on linguistic completion priors and structural formatting over actual visual evidence.
